name: cozypowers
description: Zero-code Claude Code plugins by Cozybara: cozypowers (lean solo-dev methodology), cozydesign (design-engineering skills) and cozyfounder (test a business before you launch it).

plugins.name: cozypowers
plugins.description: A lean, solo-developer software methodology for Claude Code: brainstorm before building, plan in small bites, test-drive the logic, debug by root cause, and ship with a clean conscience. No hooks, no scripts, no telemetry.

plugins.name: cozydesign
plugins.description: Design-engineering skills so generated interfaces stop looking generated: motion, layout, typography, color, accessibility, landing pages, taste memory, and evidence-based design reviews. Clean-room recreations of popular community design skills. No hooks, no scripts, no telemetry.

plugins.name: cozyfounder
plugins.description: Eleven skills that test a business before you launch it: a board of three framework lenses, a competitor scout, a simulated buyer panel, pricing, the offer, a CFO, marketing, brand, operations, a launch plan and a business plan with a computed verdict. Clean-room recreation of the founder-skill pack. No hooks, no scripts, no telemetry.
